description: This PHP file is part of a web UI for managing device access controls. It includes server-side PHP code for generating an HTML form with embedded JavaScript for handling client-side interactions, form validation, and AJAX requests to manage allowed devices on a network, including features like MAC address validation, time restrictions, day selection, and UI initialization.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from system configuration or device data.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for specified device data instances.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Returns list of instance IDs for given device data root.
